SELECT s.id, s.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, s.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.spec, p.unit, s.quantity, p.min_stock, p.max_stock, p.cost_price, CASE WHEN p.min_stock IS NOT NULL AND p.min_stock > 0 AND s.quantity < p.min_stock THEN 1 WHEN p.max_stock IS NOT NULL AND p.max_stock > 0 AND s.quantity > p.max_stock THEN 2 ELSE NULL END AS warning_type, (SELECT SUM(s2.quantity) FROM stock s2 WHERE s2.product_id = s.product_id AND s2.deleted = 0) AS total_stock FROM stock s LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND ( (p.min_stock IS NOT NULL AND p.min_stock > 0 AND s.quantity < p.min_stock) OR (p.max_stock IS NOT NULL AND p.max_stock > 0 AND s.quantity > p.max_stock) )
AND s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
AND p.min_stock IS NOT NULL AND p.min_stock > 0 AND s.quantity < p.min_stock
AND p.max_stock IS NOT NULL AND p.max_stock > 0 AND s.quantity > p.max_stock
ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.min_stock IS NOT NULL AND p.min_stock > 0 AND s.quantity < p.min_stock THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, s.warehouse_id

SELECT s.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, s.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.spec, p.unit, s.quantity AS book_quantity FROM stock s INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} ORDER BY p.product_code ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.product_id) FROM stock s INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0
AND s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
